\par\smallskip\raggedright\footnotesize\textit{Source: Authors' own work.} EARS, mean $\pm$ SD over 10 seeds; $\Delta$: paired difference in nDCG@10 against the dense counterpart with 95\% $t$-interval. Shared mask (CKKS): in round 1 the server draws $k$ coordinates with a seed; from round 2 it selects the $k$ largest-magnitude coordinates of the previous decrypted global update. All clients pack the same coordinates in the same order, so ciphertext slot $j$ holds the same parameter for every client and homomorphic addition is exact. The mask is broadcast as a bitmap or as int32 indices, whichever is smaller, and counted in Mask (MB). Per-client Top-$k$ (plaintext): each client sends its own $k$ largest coordinates as (float32 value, int32 index) pairs, all counted in Upload. No error feedback is used in either scheme.
